title: Gift Deed Of Gift Of Building By Owner In Favour Of Local Authority For Use By Public For Exercise And Recreation Purposes
description: A gift deed of gift of building by owner in favour of local authority for use by public for exercise and recreation purposes used for testamentary documents (wills) or gift deeds for transfer of property. Suitable for testators making wills, donors gifting property, or their legal advisors. Key details required: Date (First Party), Date (Second Party), Name (First Party), Name (Second Party), Signatory Name.
description_hi: Gift Deed Of Gift Of Building By Owner In Favour Of Local Authority For Use By Public For Exercise And Recreation Purposes — वसीयतनामा (वसीयत) या संपत्ति हस्तांतरण के लिए उपहार विलेख के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला कानूनी प्रारूप। वसीयत बनाने वाले वसीयतकर्ता, संपत्ति उपहार देने वाले दाता, या उनके कानूनी सलाहकार के लिए उपयुक्त। 5 आवश्यक और 2 वैकल्पिक विवरण भरने होंगे।
